### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues were identified for the change rejecting invalid weekly-job weekdays during setup. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #1015 by rejecting invalid `WeeklyJob` weekdays during setup, preventing first-run calculation from hanging with `DaylightSavingsTimeSkip`. **Changes:** - Validate every weekday against the inclusive Sunday–Saturday range. - Return the new exported `ErrWeeklyJobDaysOfTheWeek` error for invalid values. - Add regression cases for values below and above the range and mixed valid/invalid callback results. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | scheduler_test.go | Adds invalid-weekday regression cases with DST skip options. | | job.go | Rejects out-of-range weekdays before accepting the weekly schedule. | | errors.go | Defines the exported weekday-range validation error. |
Review effort: Balanced
